definitions.explanation: The act of a person, group, power, or phenomenon rising to prominence or becoming influential.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{勢力|せいりょく}が{台頭|たいとう}してきた。
examples.english: A new power has risen to prominence.

examples.japanese: AIの{台頭|たいとう}により、{働|はたら}き{方|かた}が{大|おお}きく{変|か}わった。
examples.english: The rise of AI has greatly changed the way we work.

examples.japanese: {若手|わかて}アーティストの{台頭|たいとう}が{目立|めだ}つ。
examples.english: The emergence of young artists is noticeable.

notes:
USAGE:
・{台頭|たいとう}する - to rise, emerge, come to prominence
・{台頭|たいとう}してくる - to begin rising (emerging trend)

ETYMOLOGY:
{台|たい} (platform, pedestal) + {頭|とう} (head) - literally "head rising above the platform"

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{新興|しんこう}{国|こく}の{台頭|たいとう} - rise of emerging nations
・ナショナリズムの{台頭|たいとう} - rise of nationalism
・{若手|わかて}の{台頭|たいとう} - emergence of young talent

NUANCE:
Often used for significant historical, political, or social changes. Has a somewhat formal, journalistic tone.
